incident_text: The river has overflowed and flooded the fields and part of the city.

result.scene_summary: A satellite image comparing two views of a river system with urban areas, showing changes in the landscape, particularly around a large river bend with islands and surrounding towns.

observations.description: Clouds or smoke plumes visible in the lower image over West Memphis and the riverbanks.
Urban areas including West Memphis, Memphis, Mud Island, and Treasure Island with labeled regions.
Roads and linear features connecting urban areas to the river and surrounding lands.
A large river system with visible bends and islands, including Mud Island and Treasure Island.
Areas of green vegetation surrounding urban regions and islands, indicating natural land cover.
The top image shows clear, dry riverbanks; the bottom image shows the same areas with smoke or cloud cover.
